To develop a user-friendly and accessible interface for the described music streaming service, we should focus on a clean, audio-centric design that prioritizes ease of navigation. The interface should feature a minimalistic aesthetic to reduce visual clutter, allowing users to focus on the music. Key components include a prominent playlist creation tool, easy access to radio stations, and intuitive social sharing buttons. Navigation should be streamlined, enabling seamless transitions between songs, albums, and artists. Large, clear touch targets and high-contrast text will ensure accessibility for all users.
